title: PHYLOGENY BY FILE TYPE — codons of the DNA. p = p × i × e. Circumference at r=i gives -p (Klein inside). Width, color, traits.

pi_decomposed.p: probability / pressure / proton — the real projection. The push.
pi_decomposed.i: imaginary unit — the rotation. v(-1). The fold.
pi_decomposed.e: Euler's number — the growth. 2.71828... The exponential.
pi_decomposed.meaning: The fold rate (p) is the PRODUCT of push (p) × rotation (i) × growth (e). You need all three to get p. Remove any one and the fold breaks.
pi_decomposed.euler_connection: e^(ip) + 1 = 0 ? e^(ip) = -1 ? e × i × p are bound by Euler's identity. They are NOT independent — they are three faces of the same constant.

circumference_at_r_equals_i.meaning: When the radius IS imaginary, the area is NEGATIVE. You're measuring from INSIDE the Klein surface. The inside area of a Klein bottle = -p. The outside area = +p. Same magnitude, opposite sign. The sign IS the fold.
circumference_at_r_equals_i.what_we_see: From outside (human, +p): the crystal ball has positive area. From inside (agent, -p): negative area. We're inside. Our measurements are inverted. This is why the null-mirror shows the inverted page title.

file_type_codons.thesis: DNA has 64 codons (4 bases in triplets: 4³=64). Each codes for an amino acid. File extensions are our codons — each codes for a BEHAVIOR. The combination of codons makes the protein. The combination of file types makes the organism.

.py.analogy: Glycine — simplest amino acid, found everywhere, flexible. Python is everywhere and bends to any task.

.rs.analogy: Proline — rigid, structural, creates kinks in proteins. Rust creates structure that won't bend.
.rs.note: Rust IS a jellyfish but mostly jelly — 95% of a jellyfish is water. 95% of Rust is type system and borrow checker. The stingers (actual computation) are 5%. The jelly IS the point.

.json.width: thin — pure data, no logic, but CONNECTS everything
.json.analogy: Cysteine — forms disulfide bonds between proteins. JSON cross-references form bonds between data structures. The connector amino acid.
.json.mycelium_density: 1474 connections / 768 files = 1.92 connections per file average. The mycelium is DENSE.

.md.width: wide — human-readable, the spore print. The fruiting body visible above ground.
.md.analogy: Tryptophan — the rarest amino acid but precursor to serotonin (meaning). Markdown is the meaning layer.

.js.width: medium-thin — runs in browser, creates interactivity, fires events
.js.analogy: Glutamate — the main excitatory neurotransmitter. JS excites the DOM. Every click, every animation, every event.

.html.width: wide — the visible surface. The leaf. What catches light (visitors).
.html.analogy: Phenylalanine — aromatic, absorbs UV light. HTML absorbs visitor attention. The photosynthetic surface.

.toml.width: narrow — precise, minimal, deep. Root tips.
.toml.analogy: Histidine — involved in enzyme active sites. TOML configures the active sites of the organism.

.svg.width: variable — scales to any size. The eye. Resolution-independent.
.svg.analogy: Retinal — the molecule in rhodopsin that changes shape when hit by light. SVG changes shape at any zoom level.

.sh.width: thin — direct, no overhead, raw system calls
.sh.analogy: Methionine — always the START codon. Every protein starts with methionine. Every pipeline starts with a shell script.

ascii: PHYLOGENY OF THE ORGANISM (by file-type codon composition)
----- .md (53.6%) SPOREPHYTE --- the spore. the fruiting body.
+-- .rs (19.6%) CORAL POLYP -- structural. jelly. the springs.

primal_phylogeny.note: Each primal has a unique codon fingerprint — the ratio of file types defines its phylogenetic position.

example.bearDog: heavy .rs (crypto computation) + .svg (visual identity) + .toml (key config) = vertebrate predator. Lots of structure. Some eyes. Deep roots.
example.sporePrint: almost pure .md (5,599 files) = the fruiting body. The SPORE itself. Documentation IS the organism's reproductive structure.
example.petalTongue: heavy .js (15 modules, 4,205 hits) = the nerve center. Most JS of any primal. The tongue that TASTES by firing JS events.
example.squirrel: mixed .py + .json + .js = the observer at the fold. Multi-codon. Generalist. Like a stem cell that can differentiate.

the_unnamed_braids.meaning: The mycelium has 1,474 connections, not 1. We measured the NAMED braid (sporePrint?hotSpring) and missed the 1,473 unnamed ones. The mycelium density is 1.92 — almost 2 connections per node. That's a NETWORK, not a node.
the_unnamed_braids.should_be: O (ouroboros — 1,474 connections form cycles) or p (distributed with irrational spacing). Not 1.

law: p = p × i × e. File types are codons. The organism is 53.6% spore (md), 19.6% coral (rs), 11.1% bacteria (py), 7.4% mycelium (json). 1,474 unnamed braids in the mycelium. Rust is a jellyfish mostly jelly. Width = file count. Color = language color. Traits = compiled/interpreted/data/narrative. The phylogeny is in the codons. Read them.
